title: cargo-crumbkit/guide-report/v1
description: The report of one run of the "Suggest guides from usage" job of cargo crumbkit's skill, which turns one tool's self usage findings into guide text and tool changes.

tool.description: The binary name of the tool whose usage log was read, such as shelf.

repository.description: The tool's repository, such as its path or its owner/name.

window.description: The --since value that the job passed to self usage and self runs list, such as 14d.

since.description: The day in UTC on which the report of self usage starts, such as 2026-11-05, or null when the job could not read it.

runs.description: The runs that self usage read.

sessions.description: The sessions that the runs came from.

outcome.description: skipped when the tool has no self usage command or its log holds no runs, fail when the report holds a suggestion, and pass otherwise. A rejected command never makes the outcome fail.

suggestions.description: One suggestion per command with a finding of at least 5 runs that passed the cost test, the most runs first.

rejected.description: The commands whose findings failed the cost test, because they cost a caller nothing, each with the reason. A rejected command never makes the outcome fail.

command.description: The command path, such as books show.

reason.description: Why the findings cost a caller nothing, such as a p95 of 1,941 ms for a slow command.

not_judged.description: The findings that the job did not judge, with the reason, such as fewer than 5 runs in the row's runs field.

proposals.description: The proposals for crumbkit itself: a cause that the usage log cannot show, or a tool change that no affordance covers, with the feature crumbkit could offer. A proposal never makes the outcome fail.

text.description: What is missing, and the feature crumbkit could offer in its place.

findings.description: The findings that showed the gap, each as its finding and command, such as "identical repeat: books list".

unverified.description: The suggestions whose guide text the job could not check, because the tool has no commands list. They count in no outcome.

note.description: A one-line verdict. It also names a difference between the installed binary that wrote the log and the checkout that the guide lines were checked against, and two crumbkit versions in Cargo.lock.

finding.description: The finding as self usage names it, such as identical repeat.

runs.description: The row's runs field, which counts the runs that show the finding, less any repeats the job left out because their output differed.

code.description: The failure code of a retry after failure, or null for any other finding.

Suggestion.description: The guide text and the tool change for the findings of one command.

command.description: The command path of the findings, such as books show.

findings.description: Every finding of the command with at least 5 runs, merged into this one suggestion.

made_by.description: agent when most of the runs came from coding agents, and program when most came from a program such as a daemon or a poller.

intent.description: What the callers were probably trying to do, and the runs before and after the findings that show it.

guide.description: The guide text, which passed cargo crumbkit tool-skill check and names every required argument, or null for a suggestion made by a program.

guide_target.description: Where the guide text goes: skill for the tool's SKILL.md, topic for a help topic, or null when there is no guide text.

tool_change.description: The change that would remove the cause.

change_to.description: tool when the change belongs to the tool, and program when it belongs to the program that calls the tool.

affordances.description: The affordances that the tool change would use, as AFFORDANCES.md names them. An affordance newer than the tool's crumbkit version needs an upgrade first.

guide_enough.description: True when the guide text alone is the whole fix and the tool needs no change. Always false for a suggestion made by a program.

written_to.description: The place the job wrote the suggestion, such as a task's path or an issue's URL, or null when the suggestion is only in this report.
